messages:
maria: Heads-up — Sales submitted a private deployment intake for Sable Logistics. They want a VPC + on-prem (airgapped) option and BYO-HSM for key management. Sales is pushing for a 3-month timeline. Can product/eng triage feasibility and blockers? Link to ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/SD-9876 :eyes:

ajay: Saw the ticket. Quick callouts: HSM integration (KMIP or vendor SDK), airgap packaging for images, network peering details, cert provisioning, and a signed EULA for private control plane. Also need to know whether they want managed control plane or fully customer-run.

tess: HSM: do they require FIPS 140-2 level or a specific vendor? Without vendor & mode (KMIP vs PKCS11) we can't firm estimates.

dylan: I talked to Sally (sales). They named Thales nShield and said "bring-your-own-HSM" is mandatory. Also they expect a lighter operator footprint — they asked for a K8s operator + helm/tarball install path.

maria: Quick proposal for an MVP scope so we can estimate:
- VPC peering + private control plane (minimal features)
- Airgap operator image tarball + install script
- BYO-HSM support via KMIP + docs
- Install runbook + smoke tests + escalation matrix
- Pricing + one-time setup fee + optional managed support

ajay: Sounds good. Add cert automation (ACME not available in airgap) -> provide step to inject certs and validation. Also require customer SRE for on-prem run; our field eng will be consultative.

tess: Rough dev estimates (very preliminary):
- HSM integration (KMIP client + key lifecycle): 3-4 weeks
- Airgap packaging & installer tweaks: 2 weeks
- Operator adjustments & helm: 2 weeks
- E2E smoke tests + runbook + docs: 1 week
=> ~8-9w engineering calendar, can overlap some tasks. Assumes 1 eng full-time + 0.5 ops.

dylan: Sales wants a ballpark for setup fee + monthly cost bump. My first cut: one-time services $25-40k, monthly premium for dedicated infra/support ~$5-15k depending on sizing and SLAs. I'll confirm with finance. :thumbsup:

maria: Draft launch criteria (for product triage):
1) HSM-backed key operations verified in staging (generate, sign, attest)
2) Airgap install completes in lab (operator up, control plane reachable)
3) Automated smoke tests pass (auth, generate path, embedding)
4) Runbook + rollback steps documented and validated with customer SRE
5) Security/compliance signoff (legal + infosec)
6) Pricing & support contract agreed with sales
Any missing items?

ajay: Add: monitoring hooks (token-level cost/latency), fallback policy to hosted variant if model pool exhausted, and a clear rollback path for control-plane upgrades. Also define SLA targets for latency and availability.

tess: I'll draft acceptance tests covering: Key rotation with HSM, KV cache persistence, model fallback, and high-latency network behavior. Will attach test matrix.

infra-bot: Deployment request created: RDW-4821. POC environment scheduled for 2026-03-15.

maria: Next steps I propose:
- Ajay: surface infra constraints + rough infra cost by Thu
- Tess: produce acceptance test matrix and example runbook by Fri
- Dylan: confirm HSM vendor details & get pricing/contract notes by EOD tomorrow
- Product: slot for backlog triage Mon (priority ask from sales, propose MVP scope vs full scope)

I'll capture this thread into the intake card and add to Monday's agenda. Thanks all. :pray:

dylan: I'll ping Sally and get Thales paperwork + network CIDRs. Update by EOD tomorrow.
